description: Holds all extended rights on the target, including User-Force-Change-Password and replication rights.

telemetry.detail: DS Access for the specific extended right exercised - requires object auditing.
Score reflects the quietest available extended-right abuse; the chosen primitive (password reset, LAPS read, DCSync) sets the real cost.

abuse_primitive: Any extended-right abuse: ForceChangePassword, ReadLAPSPassword, or (on the domain) DCSync.
notes: On the domain object this implies DCSync (85). On a user it implies ForceChangePassword. Treat as an umbrella - the concrete abuse governs noise.
